Yuqorida chapda ko'k yorliqda oq '2' va yonida 'Night and Day'.

CHAP USTUN:
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Grammar: Present Simple' sarlavhasi.
• Och ko'k-yashil ramkali 'Use' qutisi: 'We use the present simple to talk about daily routines and habits. e.g. He goes to work by bus.'
10) 'Write the verbs in the third person singular.' Ikki ustunda 10 qator: 1 I go - he ...; 2 I watch - he ...; 3 I play - he ...; 4 I read - he ...; 5 I have - he ...; 6 I finish - he ...; 7 I make - he ...; 8 I leave - he ...; 9 I do - he ...; 10 I brush - he ...
11) (kassetа belgisi bilan) a) 'Listen and fill in what John does at the following times. Can you guess his job?' b) 'Look at the table and talk about John's daily routine, as in the example.' Ostida och sariq-jigarrang jadval: 5:00 am wake up, have shower; 6:00 am have 1)...; 6:45 am 2)... the house, catch bus; 8:30 am start work; 1:30 pm 3)... lunch; 4:30 pm 4)... work, take bus home; 6:15 pm get home; 8:15 pm have dinner, then go out/read a book; 11:00 pm go to bed. Ostida ko'k qiya namuna: 'John wakes up at 5:00 am and has a shower ...'
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Grammar: Adverbs of Frequency' sarlavhasi.
12) 'List the adverbs of frequency, then say where we usually place such adverbs in a sentence.' Ro'yxat qiya harflarda: often, occasionally, sometimes, usually, rarely. 13) 'Use adverbs of frequency to say how often you do the following activities:' oltita band.

   b) 'What about you? Write your own timetable for Mondays, then tell your partner about it.' Ko'k qiya namuna.

15) (kassetа belgisi bilan) 'Fill in how, how long or how far, then listen and check. Finally, in pairs, use the prompts below to act out similar dialogues.' A va B dialogi, uchta nuqtali joy; javoblarda tagiga chizilgan so'zlar. Ostida to'rtta nuqtali ko'rsatma bandi.

exercises.instructionEn: We use the present simple to talk about daily routines and habits. e.g. He goes to work by bus.
exercises.instructionUz: Present simple ni kundalik tartib va odatlar haqida gapirish uchun ishlatamiz. Masalan: U ishga avtobusda boradi.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI 'USE' QUTISI.

  'We use the present simple to talk
   about daily routines and habits.'
  e.g. He goes to work by bus.

  ⚠ 'e.g.' = 'exempli gratia' (lotincha)
  = masalan.


⚠ 'BY BUS' - TRANSPORT USULI:

  by bus, by car, by train, by plane,
  by bike, by taxi

  ⚠ ARTIKLSIZ! 'by a bus' - XATO.
  ⚠ ISTISNO: 'ON FOOT' = piyoda
  ('by foot' XATO).


3-ShAXS BIRLIKDAGI -S QOIDALARI
(10-mashqning butun mavzusi):

  1) Ko'pchilik fe'lga oddiy -S:
     play → plays, read → reads,
     make → makes, leave → leaves

  2) -O, -S, -SH, -CH, -X bilan
     tugasa → -ES:
     go → goes, do → does,
     watch → watches, finish → finishes,
     brush → brushes, fix → fixes

  3) UNDOSh + Y → -IES:
     study → studies, fly → flies

  4) UNLI + Y → faqat -S:
     play → plays, buy → buys

  5) ISTISNO: have → HAS


⚠ -S NING TALAFFUZI - UCh XIL:

  /s/  - jarangsiz tovushdan keyin:
     makes, sleeps, works
  /z/  - jarangli tovushdan keyin:
     plays, reads, goes
  /iz/ - shivirlovchi tovushdan keyin:
     watches, finishes, brushes

  ⚠ Bu qoida ko'plik -S ga ham,
  o'tgan zamon -ED ga ham o'xshash.

points.en: We use the present simple to talk about daily routines and habits.
points.uz: Present simple ni kundalik tartib va odatlar haqida gapirish uchun ishlatamiz.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'a routine' = kundalik tartib.
⚠ 'a habit' = odat.

⚠ Belgi so'zlari: always, usually, often,
sometimes, never, every day.

points.en: e.g. He goes to work by bus.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'go' → 'goES' (-O dan keyin -ES).
⚠ 'BY bus' - ARTIKLSIZ.
⚠ 'to work' - artiklsiz.

⚠ 'e.g.' = masalan (lotincha 'exempli gratia').

exercises.instructionEn: Write the verbs in the third person singular.
exercises.explanationUz:
3-ShAXS BIRLIK (he/she/it).

  ⚠ Bu - ingliz tilidagi eng ko'p
  unutiladigan qoida. O'zbekchada
  fe'l shaxsga qarab o'zgarmaydi,
  shuning uchun -S doim esdan chiqadi.


QOIDALAR VA BANDLAR:

  ODDIY -S:
     play → plays (3)
     read → reads (4)
     make → makes (7)
     leave → leaves (8)

  -O, -S, -SH, -CH, -X → -ES:
     go → goes (1)
     watch → watches (2)
     finish → finishes (6)
     do → does (9)
     brush → brushes (10)

  ISTISNO:
     have → has (5)


⚠ 'DOES' TALAFFUZI:

  'do' /duː/ → 'does' /dʌz/
  ⚠ Unli TOVUSh o'zgaradi!

  ⚠ Xuddi shunday 'say' /seɪ/ →
  'says' /sez/.


⚠ INKOR VA SO'ROQDA -S TUShADI:

  He goes. → He doesn't GO.
  He goes? → Does he GO?

  ⚠ 'He doesn't goes' - XATO.
  ⚠ -S allaqachon 'does' ichida.

items.whyUz:
⚠ -O bilan tugagani uchun -ES.
⚠ Talaffuzi /gəʊz/.

⚠ -CH bilan tugagani uchun -ES.
⚠ Talaffuzi /ˈwɒtʃɪz/ - qo'shimcha BO'G'IN
qo'shiladi.

⚠ UNLI + Y, shuning uchun faqat -S.
⚠ 'plaies' - XATO.

⚠ Oddiy -S.
⚠ Talaffuzi /riːdz/ - jarangli /z/.

⚠ ISTISNO! 'haves' - XATO.
⚠ Faqat 'have' shunday o'zgaradi.

⚠ -SH bilan tugagani uchun -ES.
⚠ Qo'shimcha BO'G'IN: /ˈfɪnɪʃɪz/.

⚠ Oddiy -S.
⚠ Talaffuzi /meɪks/ - jarangsiz /s/.

⚠ Oddiy -S.
⚠ 'a leaf' (barg) → 'leaves' bilan ADAShTIRMANG -
u OT ko'pligi.

⚠ -O bilan tugagani uchun -ES.
⚠ TALAFFUZ O'ZGARADI: /duː/ → /dʌz/.

⚠ -SH bilan tugagani uchun -ES.
⚠ 'to brush your teeth' = tish yuvmoq.

exercises.audioRequiredUz: Jadvaldagi to'rtta bo'shliq audiodan to'ldiriladi; javoblar jadval mantiqidan ham aniq ko'rinadi.
exercises.instructionEn: a) Listen and fill in what John does at the following times. Can you guess his job? b) Look at the table and talk about John's daily routine, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: a) Tinglang va Jon quyidagi vaqtlarda nima qilishini yozing. Uning kasbini taxmin qila olasizmi? b) Jadvalga qarab Jonning kundalik tartibi haqida gapiring, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
JONNING KUNI.

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'John wakes up at 5:00 am and has a
   shower ...'

  ⚠ 'wakeS' va 'haS' - 3-shaxs birlik -S.


TO'LIQ JADVAL:

  5:00 am  wake up, have shower
  6:00 am  have BREAKFAST
  6:45 am  LEAVE the house, catch bus
  8:30 am  start work
  1:30 pm  HAVE lunch
  4:30 pm  FINISH work, take bus home
  6:15 pm  get home
  8:15 pm  have dinner, then go out/
           read a book
  11:00 pm go to bed


⚠ UNING KASBI QANDAY?

  Jon soat 5:00 da turadi va 8:30 da
  ishni boshlaydi - ya'ni ish joyi
  UZOQ (avtobusda ~1,5 soat).

  ⚠ Kasbini aniq aytish uchun audio
  kerak, lekin jadvaldan ko'rinadiki:
  u erta turadi, avtobusda qatnaydi,
  ish 8:30-4:30 - odatiy IDORA yoki
  ZAVOD ishi.


⚠ VAQT PREDLOGI 'AT':

  AT 5:00 am - aniq soat
  IN the morning - kunning qismi
  ON Monday - kun

  ⚠ 'at night' - ISTISNO ('in the night'
  emas).


⚠ 'GET HOME' va 'GO HOME':

  go home = uyga jo'namoq
  get home = uyga YETIB BORMOQ

  ⚠ Ikkalasi ham predlogsiz -
  'home' bu yerda RAVISh.


⚠ 'CATCH A BUS' va 'TAKE A BUS':

  catch the bus = avtobusga ulgurmoq
  take the bus = avtobusda bormoq

  ⚠ Jadvalda ikkalasi ham bor:
  ertalab 'catch bus', kechqurun
  'take bus home'.

items.whyUz:
⚠ 'have breakfast' - ARTIKLSIZ.
⚠ 'have A breakfast' - XATO.

⚠ 'to leave the house' = uydan chiqmoq.
⚠ 10-mashqda 'leave' fe'li bor edi.

⚠ 'have lunch' - ARTIKLSIZ.
⚠ 12-betdagi 1a mashqida ham 'have' + ovqat.

⚠ 'to finish work' - artiklsiz.
⚠ 10-mashqda 'finish' fe'li bor edi.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the table and talk about John's daily routine, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Jadvalga qarab Jonning kundalik tartibi haqida gapiring, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
JADVALDAN GAP TUZISH.

  ⚠ Har qatordan bitta gap chiqadi.

  ⚠ Qolip: He + FE'L + S + at + SOAT.

  ⚠ 3-shaxs birlik -S ni UNUTMANG:
     wakeS, haS, leaveS, startS,
     finishES, getS, goES.


⚠ IKKI ISh BITTA GAPDA:

  'He leaves the house at 6:45 am AND
   catches the bus.'

  ⚠ Ikkinchi fe'lga ham -S qo'shiladi!
  'and catch the bus' - XATO.
exercises.exampleEn: John wakes up at 5:00 am and has a shower.
exercises.exampleUz: Jon soat 5:00 da uyg'onadi va dush qabul qiladi.
modelAnswers: John wakes up at 5:00 am and has a shower.
He leaves the house at 6:45 am and catches the bus.
He finishes work at 4:30 pm and takes the bus home.
He has dinner at 8:15 pm and then goes out or reads a book.
He goes to bed at 11:00 pm.
modelAnswersUz: Jon soat 5:00 da uyg'onadi va dush qabul qiladi.
U 6:45 da uydan chiqadi va avtobusga o'tiradi.
U 16:30 da ishni tugatadi va avtobusda uyga qaytadi.
U 20:15 da kechki ovqat qiladi, keyin tashqariga chiqadi yoki kitob o'qiydi.

exercises.instructionEn: List the adverbs of frequency, then say where we usually place such adverbs in a sentence.
exercises.instructionUz: Takrorlanish ravishlarini tartib bilan yozing, so'ng gapda ular odatda qayerga qo'yilishini ayting.
exercises.explanationUz:
TAKRORLANISh RAVIShLARI - 0% dan
100% gacha.

  1  never        0%
  2  rarely       ~10%
  3  occasionally ~25%
  4  sometimes    ~40%
  5  often        ~60%
  6  usually      ~85%
  7  always       100%

  ⚠ Kitobda 1 (never) va 7 (always)
  BERILGAN - qolgan beshtasini
  ro'yxatdan joylashtirasiz.


⚠ GAPDA QAYERGA QO'YILADI - UCh QOIDA:

  1) ODDIY FE'LDAN OLDIN:
     'I ALWAYS get up early.'
     'He OFTEN plays football.'

  2) 'TO BE' DAN KEYIN:
     'She is ALWAYS late.'
     'They are USUALLY at home.'
     ⚠ 'She always is late' - XATO!

  3) YORDAMChI FE'L BILAN - o'rtada:
     'I have NEVER been to London.'
     'He can USUALLY come.'

  ⚠ Qisqa qoida: ravish ASOSIY fe'ldan
  oldin, lekin 'to be' dan KEYIN.


⚠ ISTISNO - GAP BOShIDA VA OXIRIDA:

  'sometimes', 'usually', 'often',
  'occasionally' gap boshida ham
  turishi mumkin:
     'Sometimes I go to the cinema.'

  ⚠ Lekin 'always' va 'never' gap
  boshida TURMAYDI (buyruq gapdan
  tashqari: 'Never do that!').


⚠ 'RARELY', 'SELDOM', 'HARDLY EVER':

  Uchalasi ham 'kamdan-kam' degani.
  ⚠ Ular INKOR ma'noli, shuning uchun
  gapda yana 'not' QO'ShILMAYDI:
  'I rarely don't go' - XATO.


⚠ 'HOW OFTEN ...?' - SAVOL:

  'How often do you play tennis?'
     - 'Twice a week.'
     - 'I usually play at weekends.'

pairs.whyUz:
⚠ Kitobda BERILGAN.
⚠ 'never' INKOR ma'noli - gapda yana 'not'
qo'shilmaydi.

⚠ 'an occasion' (holat, hodisa) so'zidan.
⚠ Imlosiga diqqat: IKKI 'c', BITTA 's'.

⚠ 'sometimes' (ba'zan) va 'some times'
(bir necha marta) - ADAShTIRMANG.
⚠ 'sometime' (qachondir) ham boshqa so'z.

⚠ 't' harfi odatda O'QILMAYDI: /ˈɒfn/.
⚠ 'How OFTEN ...?' savolining o'zagi.

exercises.instructionEn: Use adverbs of frequency to say how often you do the following activities.
exercises.instructionUz: Takrorlanish ravishlaridan foydalanib, quyidagi ishlarni qanchalik tez-tez qilishingizni ayting.
exercises.explanationUz:
OLTITA MAShG'ULOT:

  • make your bed in the morning
  • do the washing-up
  • play basketball on Mondays
  • visit relatives at weekends
  • watch the evening news on TV
  • brush your teeth before going
    to bed


⚠ RAVIShNI QAYERGA QO'YISh:

  'I ALWAYS make my bed in the morning.'
     (asosiy fe'ldan OLDIN)

  ⚠ 'I make always my bed' - XATO.


⚠ 'MAKE THE BED' - COLLOCATION:

  ⚠ 'to make the bed' = to'shakni yig'moq.
  'do the bed' - XATO.

  ⚠ 12-betdagi 1a mashqida 'do' va 'make'
  farqi tushuntirilgan edi.


⚠ 'AT WEEKENDS' va 'ON MONDAYS':

  at weekends - dam olish kunlari
     (Britaniya; AQShda 'on weekends')
  on MondayS - har dushanba
     ⚠ KO'PLIK -S 'har dushanba' ma'nosini
     beradi.


⚠ 'RELATIVES':

  = qarindoshlar.
  ⚠ 'a relative' - 'to relate' (bog'lanmoq)
  fe'lidan.


⚠ 'BEFORE GOING TO BED':

  ⚠ 'before' PREDLOG bo'lganda keyin
  -ING keladi: 'before GOING'.
  ⚠ 'before I go to bed' ham to'g'ri
  (bog'lovchi sifatida).
exercises.exampleEn: I always make my bed in the morning.
exercises.exampleUz: Men har doim ertalab to'shagimni yig'aman.
modelAnswers: I always make my bed in the morning.
I rarely play basketball on Mondays.
I usually visit relatives at weekends.
I occasionally watch the evening news on TV.
I never go to bed without brushing my teeth.
modelAnswersUz: Men har doim ertalab to'shagimni yig'aman.
Men dushanba kunlari kamdan-kam basketbol o'ynayman.
Men odatda dam olish kunlari qarindoshlarimni yo'qlayman.
Men vaqti-vaqti bilan kechki yangiliklarni ko'raman.
Men hech qachon tishimni yuvmasdan uxlamayman.

exercises.audioRequiredUz: Sinfxona RAQAMLARI faqat audioda aytiladi - jadvaldagi bo'sh katakchalarni yozuvsiz to'ldirib bo'lmaydi.
exercises.instructionEn: a) Listen and fill in the missing information, then ask and answer questions in pairs, as in the example. b) What about you? Write your own timetable for Mondays, then tell your partner about it.
exercises.instructionUz: a) Tinglang va yetishmayotgan ma'lumotni yozing, so'ng juftlikda savol-javob qiling, namunadagidek. b) Sizchi? Dushanba uchun o'z dars jadvalingizni yozing va sherigingizga aytib bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
DUShANBA KUNGI DARS JADVALI:

  9:10 - 10:00   Maths (Classroom ⚠)
  10:10 - 11:00  Geography (Classroom ⚠)
  11:00 - 11:30  BREAK
  11:30 - 12:20  Chemistry (the Science Lab)
  12:20 - 1:30   LUNCH (the school cafeteria)
  1:30 - 2:20    History (Classroom ⚠)
  2:30 - 3:20    Art (Classroom ⚠)

  * ⚠ Maths sinfxonasining raqami - audiodan
  * ⚠ Geography sinfxonasining raqami - audiodan
  * ⚠ History sinfxonasining raqami - audiodan
  * ⚠ Art sinfxonasining raqami - audiodan


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  SA: What time does Tom have Maths?
  SB: He has Maths from 9:10 till 10:00.
  SA: Where does he have Maths?
  SB: In classroom ...


⚠ 'FROM ... TILL/TO ...':

  'from 9:10 till 10:00'
  ⚠ 'till' = 'until' ning qisqa shakli.
  ⚠ 'from ... to ...' ham to'g'ri.
  ⚠ 'from' bo'lsa 'till/to' ham ShART.


⚠ MAKTAB FANLARI - KATTA HARF BILAN:

  Maths, Geography, Chemistry,
  History, Art, Physics, Biology,
  English, Literature

  ⚠ Fan nomlari ATOQLI ot hisoblanadi.
  ⚠ ARTIKLSIZ: 'I have Maths' ('the
  Maths' emas).

  ⚠ 'Maths' - Britaniya qisqartmasi
  ('mathematics'); AQShda 'Math'.


⚠ 'A LAB' va 'A CAFETERIA':

  the Science Lab = fan xonasi
     ('laboratory' ning qisqasi)
  the school cafeteria = maktab oshxonasi

  ⚠ Bularning oldida 'THE' bor,
  chunki maktabda BITTA - ma'lum.


⚠ 'WHAT TIME' va 'WHEN':

  'What time does he have Maths?'
     - aniq SOAT so'raladi
  'When does he have Maths?'
     - kengroq (kun ham bo'lishi mumkin)

items.question: What time does Tom have Maths?
items.whyUz:
Kitobdagi namuna.

⚠ 'from ... till ...' - ikkalasi ham ShART.
⚠ 'haS' - 3-shaxs birlik.

items.question: Where does he have Maths?
items.whyUz:
⚠ Sinfxona raqami faqat AUDIODA.

⚠ 'IN classroom ...' - predlog 'in'.

items.question: What time does he have Geography?
items.whyUz: ⚠ Fan nomi KATTA harf bilan va ARTIKLSIZ.

items.question: When is the break?
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'a break' = tanaffus - 13-betdagi maqolada
ham bor edi ('a short break for lunch').

items.question: Where does he have Chemistry?
items.answer: He has Chemistry in the Science Lab.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'the Science Lab' - 'THE' bilan, chunki
maktabda bitta.
⚠ 'a lab' = 'a laboratory' ning qisqasi.

items.question: When and where does he have lunch?
items.answer: He has lunch from 12:20 till 1:30 in the school cafeteria.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'have lunch' - ARTIKLSIZ.
⚠ 'a cafeteria' = oshxona (o'zi olib yeyiladigan).

items.question: What time does he have History?
items.whyUz: ⚠ Fan nomi KATTA harf bilan.

items.question: What is the last lesson and when is it?
items.answer: The last lesson is Art, from 2:30 till 3:20.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'Art' - tasviriy san'at darsi.
⚠ 2:20 dan 2:30 gacha qisqa tanaffus bor.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in how, how long or how far, then listen and check. Finally, in pairs, use the prompts below to act out similar dialogues.
exercises.instructionUz: how, how long yoki how far ni qo'ying, so'ng tinglang va tekshiring. Nihoyat, juftlikda quyidagi ko'rsatmalar bilan shunga o'xshash dialoglarni ijro eting.
exercises.explanationUz:
UCh XIL 'HOW' SAVOLI.

  HOW FAR ...?   - MASOFA
     'How far is your office?'
     - 'It's 40 kilometres.'

  HOW ...?       - USUL (qanday)
     'How do you get there?'
     - 'I go by bus.'

  HOW LONG ...?  - VAQT
     'How long does it take?'
     - 'It takes nearly an hour.'

  ⚠ Javobga qarab savolni topish oson:
     kilometr → how far
     avtobus  → how
     soat     → how long


⚠ 'IT TAKES' - VAQT UChUN:

  'It takes an hour to get there.'
  = U yerga borish bir soat oladi.

  ⚠ Ega HAR DOIM 'it'.
  ⚠ Qolip: It takes + (kim) + VAQT +
     to + FE'L
     'It takes me twenty minutes to walk
      to school.'


⚠ 'GET THERE' - PREDLOGSIZ:

  'How do you get THERE?'
  ⚠ 'get to there' - XATO.
  ⚠ 'there', 'here', 'home' oldidan
  'to' QO'YILMAYDI.

  ⚠ Lekin joy nomi bilan 'to' kerak:
  'How do you get TO school?'


⚠ 'NEARLY AN HOUR':

  ⚠ 'an hour' - 'h' O'QILMAYDI, shuning
  uchun 'AN' artikli ('a hour' XATO).
  ⚠ 'nearly' = deyarli.


⚠ "I DON'T MIND":

  = qarshi emasman, parvo qilmayman.
  ⚠ 12-betdagi 2-mashqda ham bor edi.


QO'ShIMChA KO'RSATMALAR (dialog
qurish uchun):

  • your school; 4 kilometres; by bike;
    about 10 minutes; good exercise and
    I enjoy it
  • the supermarket; 15 kilometres;
    by car; 20 minutes; quite fast
    because the roads are usually quiet
  • the seaside; 40 kilometres; by train;
    30 minutes; quick, so I often go at
    weekends
  • the park; 2 kilometres; on foot;
    20 minutes; a pleasant walk, so I go
    every day

  ⚠ 'ON FOOT' - 'by foot' XATO!

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: 1) ___ is your office from your house?
lines.whyUz:
⚠ Javobda KILOMETR aytilgan - demak MASOFA
so'ralgan.
⚠ 'far FROM' - predlog 'from'.

lines.speaker: B
lines.whyUz:
⚠ Bu qatorda bo'shliq yo'q.
⚠ 'kilometres' - Britaniya imlosi
(AQShda 'kilometers').

lines.speaker: A
lines.whyUz:
⚠ Javobda TRANSPORT aytilgan - demak USUL
so'ralgan.
⚠ 'get THERE' - predlogsiz.

lines.speaker: B
lines.whyUz:
⚠ 'BY bus' - ARTIKLSIZ.
⚠ 'usually' - takrorlanish ravishi, asosiy
fe'ldan OLDIN.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: 3) ___ does it take to get there?
lines.uz: U yerga borish qancha vaqt oladi?
lines.whyUz:
⚠ Javobda SOAT aytilgan - demak VAQT so'ralgan.
⚠ 'It takes' - ega har doim 'it'.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: It takes nearly an hour. It's quite slow, but I don't mind.
lines.uz: Deyarli bir soat oladi. Ancha sekin, lekin qarshi emasman.
lines.whyUz:
⚠ 'AN hour' - 'h' O'QILMAYDI.
⚠ 'nearly' = deyarli.
⚠ "I don't mind" = parvo qilmayman.

exercises.instructionEn: In pairs, use the prompts below to act out similar dialogues.
exercises.instructionUz: Juftlikda quyidagi ko'rsatmalar bilan shunga o'xshash dialoglarni ijro eting.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'RTTA YANGI DIALOG.

  ⚠ Har ko'rsatma to'rtta ma'lumot beradi:
  joy; masofa; transport; vaqt; izoh.

  ⚠ Ularni 15-mashqdagi dialog qolipiga
  joylashtiring.

points.en: A: How far is your school from your house? B: It's 4 kilometres. A: How do you get there? B: I go by bike. A: How long does it take? B: About 10 minutes. It's good exercise and I enjoy it.
points.uz: A: Maktabing uyingdan qancha uzoqlikda? B: 4 kilometr. A: U yerga qanday borasan? B: Velosipedda. A: Qancha vaqt oladi? B: Taxminan 10 daqiqa. Yaxshi mashq va menga yoqadi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'BY bike' - artiklsiz.
⚠ 'exercise' bu ma'noda SANALMAYDIGAN:
'good exercise' ('a good exercise' emas).

points.en: A: How far is the supermarket? B: It's 15 kilometres. A: How do you get there? B: By car. A: How long does it take? B: 20 minutes. It's quite fast because the roads are usually quiet.
points.uz: A: Supermarket qancha uzoqlikda? B: 15 kilometr. A: U yerga qanday borasan? B: Mashinada. A: Qancha vaqt oladi? B: 20 daqiqa. Ancha tez, chunki yo'llar odatda bo'sh.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'quite fast' = ancha tez.
⚠ 'quiet' (jim, bo'sh) va 'quite' (ancha) -
ADAShTIRMANG! Imlosi juda o'xshash.

points.en: A: How far is the seaside? B: It's 40 kilometres. A: How do you get there? B: By train. A: How long does it take? B: 30 minutes. It's quick, so I often go at weekends.
points.uz: A: Dengiz bo'yi qancha uzoqlikda? B: 40 kilometr. A: U yerga qanday borasan? B: Poyezdda. A: Qancha vaqt oladi? B: 30 daqiqa. Tez, shuning uchun dam olish kunlari tez-tez boraman.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'the seaside' - HAR DOIM 'the' bilan.
⚠ 'at weekends' - Britaniya varianti
(AQShda 'on weekends').

points.en: A: How far is the park? B: It's 2 kilometres. A: How do you get there? B: On foot. A: How long does it take? B: 20 minutes. It's a pleasant walk, so I go every day.
points.uz: A: Bog' qancha uzoqlikda? B: 2 kilometr. A: U yerga qanday borasan? B: Piyoda. A: Qancha vaqt oladi? B: 20 daqiqa. Yoqimli sayr, shuning uchun har kuni boraman.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'ON FOOT' - 'by foot' XATO!
Bu YAGONA istisno: qolgan hamma transport
'by' bilan.
⚠ 'pleasant' = yoqimli; 'plea-' /plez/ deb
o'qiladi.

sentencePatterns.introUz: Kundalik tartib va masofa haqida savol-javob.

patterns.exampleEn: John wakes up at 5:00 am and has a shower.
patterns.exampleUz: Jon soat 5:00 da uyg'onadi va dush qabul qiladi.

patterns.exampleEn: I always make my bed in the morning.
patterns.exampleUz: Men har doim ertalab to'shagimni yig'aman.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Takrorlanish ravishi ASOSIY FE'LDAN OLDIN.
⚠ Lekin 'to be' dan KEYIN: 'She is always late.'

patterns.formula: What time does he have [fan]? - He has [fan] from ... till ...
patterns.exampleEn: What time does Tom have Maths? - He has Maths from 9:10 till 10:00.
patterns.exampleUz: Tom matematikani soat nechada o'qiydi? - 9:10 dan 10:00 gacha.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Fan nomi KATTA harf bilan va ARTIKLSIZ.
⚠ 'from ... till ...' - ikkalasi ham ShART.

patterns.exampleEn: How far is your office? - It's 40 kilometres.

patterns.formula: How long does it take? - It takes [vaqt].
patterns.exampleEn: How long does it take to get there? - It takes nearly an hour.
patterns.exampleUz: U yerga borish qancha vaqt oladi? - Deyarli bir soat.

patterns.formula: I go by [transport]. / I go on foot.
patterns.exampleEn: I usually go by bus. / I go to the park on foot.
patterns.exampleUz: Odatda avtobusda boraman. / Bog'ga piyoda boraman.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'BY' + transport, ARTIKLSIZ.
⚠ ISTISNO: 'ON foot' ('by foot' XATO).

groups.explanationUz: Betdagi bir necha so'z uzun so'zning qisqartmasi.
